title: B-tree cursor moved and pin-state primitives

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreeCursorHasMoved tests whether a cursor is outside VALID state, while sqlite3BtreeCursorPin and sqlite3BtreeCursorUnpin enforce and toggle the cursor pin bit. These three direct cursor-state primitives form one dependency-free boundary.

dependencies.caller_closure: All three direct state bodies are assigned; restore and movement callers remain open.

inputs: Live Cursor for moved observation; unpinned Cursor for pin; pinned Cursor for unpin
outputs: Moved boolean and exact pin-state transitions
contracts.ownership: Cursor is borrowed; no allocation or ownership transfer.
contracts.state_and_results: Only VALID returns not moved. Pin requires false then sets true; unpin requires true then sets false.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns B-tree serialization; no callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Invalid pin transitions violate source assertions; moved observation is total for a valid cursor object.

representation_differences: The Zig CursorState enum and pinned boolean replace source byte-state layout and BTCF_Pinned bit operations.
The fake-valid-cursor byte-layout optimization is unnecessary for typed non-null Zig callers and remains excluded.

oracle.protocol: Observe a default invalid cursor as moved, switch it to VALID and observe not moved, then pin and unpin while comparing the exact boolean state.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller serialization remains external.
assurance.malformed_input: Null/dangling cursor or repeated pin/unpin violates source/model invariants.
assurance.continuation: Valid transitions leave cursor ready for the corresponding movement restrictions.

integration.native_call_path: Typed state owners and all scalar transitions are unit-traced; native restore/movement dispatch remains pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires caller integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/btree.c:923-976 and 4919-4939 were reviewed completely for moved/restore and pin context
src/core/internal/btree_core.zig cursor state, saved-position, movement, and pin fields were reviewed
callers: Cursor movement paths requiring temporary pinning
Unit trace invokes all owners directly
assertions_branches_cleanup: All six active blocks are assigned
upstream_tests: Upstream rebalance/delete cursor restoration and cursor pin tests cover these primitives
